QUOTE: It is passed directly as `ref={ref}` to `<NavigationSearch>` at `index.tsx:~124`, and only when `hasSearch` is true. ... When `hasSearch` is false, `NavigationSearch` is not mounted, so a ref passed to `NavigationHeader` stays null.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that NavigationHeader forwards its ref to NavigationSearch, which renders only when `hasSearch` is true, so the ref stays null otherwise.
